content: Yasuɛ Netta d Abrid d Tidett d Tudart
“War ttejjim ad innehweř uř nwem. Kenniw tumnem di AREBBI, amnem ɛawed dayi.
Di taddart n Baba dayes aṭṭas n tzeddiɣin. Meɛlik war iǧi amenni, iři nniɣ awem t, minzi Necc ad raḥeɣ, ḥima ad awem sswejdeɣ amcan.
Awarni řami ruḥeɣ uca sswejdeɣ awem amcan, xenni ad ɛeqbeɣ, ad kenniw dd-awyeɣ ɣari, ḥima, mani ǧiɣ Necc, ad din tiřim uřa d kenniw.
Aqa tessnem mani ɣa raḥeɣ uca tessnem abrid.”
Inna as Tuma: “A Siditneɣ, war nessin mani ɣa traḥed i mammec nzemmar ad nessen abrid?”
Yasuɛ inna as: “NECC d Abrid d Tidett d Tudart, war dd-ittis uřa d ijj ɣar Baba mɣir zzayi.
Mařa tuɣa tessnem ayi, ad tiři aqa tessnem uřa d Baba. Zi řexxu aqa tessnem t, teẓrim t.”
Filippus inna as: “A Siditneɣ, scen aneɣ Babac, uca ikfa.”
Yasuɛ inna as: “Anect uya n řweqt qaɛ Necc akidwem, ma war d ayi tessined ɛad, a Filippus? Wenni d ayi iẓrin, iẓra Baba. Mammec teqqared: ‘Scen aneɣ Babac’?
Ma war tumined ca aqa Necc aqa ayi di Baba d Baba aqa-t dayi? Awařen i qqareɣ, war ten qqareɣ ca zi ɣari, maca Baba wenni dayi izeddɣen, Netta ittegg řexdayem-a.
Amnem ayi, aqa Necc aqa ayi di Baba u Baba aqa-t dayi, u mařa lla, amnem ayi x ssibbet n řexdayem simant nsent.
S tidett, s tidett, Necc ad awem iniɣ: Wenni dayi yumnen, aqa řexdayem i tteggeɣ, ad zzaysent igg uřa d netta, uca ad igg tinni iǧan d timeqqranin x man aya, minzi Necc ad raḥeɣ ɣar Baba.
Uca marra min ɣa tᵉttarem s Yisem inu, ad t ggeɣ i kenniw, ḥima ad ittwassɛuǧ Baba di Mmis.
Mařa d ayi ɣa tᵉttarem s Yisem inu, ad t ggeɣ.
Lwaɛd n Arruḥ Iqeddsen
Mařa texsem ayi, ṭṭfem di tweṣṣa inu,
uca Necc ad ẓẓaǧeɣ i Baba u Netta ad awem iwc ijj n Umseṣřaḥ nneɣni, ḥima ad kiwem iqqim i řebda:
Arruḥ n tidett tenni war tzemmar ddunect ad t teqbeř, minzi war t tᵉttwiři, war t tessin. Maca kenniw tessnem t, minzi Netta ittɣima akidwem u Netta aqa-t daywem.”
“War kenniw ttejjiɣ ca d iyujiřen, maɣar awarni drus n řweqt Necc ad ɣarwem dd-aseɣ ɛawed.
Ddunect war d ayi tẓarr, maca kenniw ad ayi twařam. Minzi Necc ddareɣ, ad teddarem uřa d kenniw.
Deg wass nni ad tessnem, aqa Necc aqa ayi di Baba, kenniw dayi u Necc daywem.
Wenni ɣar iǧa tiweṣṣa inu uca ad daysent iṭṭef, d wenni d ayi ittexsen, u wenni d ayi ittexsen, uřa d Baba ad t ixs u Necc ad t xseɣ ɛawed uca ad as ssecneɣ Ixef inu.”
Inna as Yahuda, war iǧi d Isxariyuṭi: “A Sidi, mammec d aneɣ i ɣa tessecned Ixef nnec, war iǧi ca i ddunect?”
Yasuɛ yarra-dd, inna as: “Mařa ca n yijjen ixs ayi, xenni ad iṭṭef deg wawař inu uca Baba ad t ixs, uca ɣares i dd ɣa nas u ɣares i ɣa negg tazeddiɣt nneɣ.
Wenni war d ayi ittexsen, war ittᵉṭṭif ca deg wawař inu, uca awař-a i tesřim, war iǧi ca zi ɣari, maca zi Baba, wenni d ayi dd-issekken.
Ssiwřeɣ akidwem man aya umi Necc ɛad akidwem.
Maca Umseṣřaḥ, Arruḥ Iqeddsen, Wenni i dd ɣa issekk Baba s Yisem inu, ad awem isseřmed kuřci, ad awem issfekkar marra min d awem nniɣ.
Řehna ad awem t jjeɣ, Necc ad awem wceɣ řehna inu. Necc ad awem t wceɣ, war iǧi ca am mammec t tᵉttic ddunect. War tejjim ad innehweř uř nwem, war tteggʷedem ca.
Aqa tesřim Necc nniɣ awem: ‘Necc ad uyureɣ uca ad ɣarwem dd-aseɣ ɛawed’. Mařa texsem ayi, ad tfarḥem, minzi aqa ad raḥeɣ ɣar Baba, minzi Baba imɣar xafi!
Uca řexxu, xzar, Necc nniɣ awem tt qbeř ma ad yiři, ḥima kenniw, x minni i ɣa yiři uya, ad tamnem.
Awarni man aya war kiwem ssiwiřeɣ ɛad aṭṭas ktar, maɣar ad dd-yas umeqqran n ddunect-a, war ɣares ittiři walu dayi,
maca ittxeṣṣa ad tessen ddunect aqa Necc ttexseɣ Baba uca tteggeɣ min d ayi iweṣṣa Baba. Kkarem, ad nuyur ssanita.”
